issue.summary: [Frontend] Frontend application scaffold and API integration layer
issue.description: As a frontend developer, I want a responsive web application scaffold (routing, base layout, and a typed API client) so that feature screens can be built on a consistent, connected foundation. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the scaffold, when a new screen is added, then it can call the backend REST API through a single shared client with consistent error handling. * Given the app is opened on a phone-sized viewport, when the base layout renders, then navigation and content remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Registration and login screens
issue.description: As a new or returning user, I want clear registration and login screens so that I can create an account or sign in without confusion. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the registration screen, when I submit invalid data (e.g. weak password, duplicate email), then I see an inline, field-specific error. * Given valid credentials on the login screen, when I submit, then I am redirected to the screen appropriate to my role.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Logout control and protected route handling
issue.description: As a logged-in user, I want a visible logout control and to be redirected away from protected screens once logged out so that my session ends cleanly. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I am logged in, when I select "Log out", then my session is cleared and I am returned to a public screen. * Given I am logged out, when I try to navigate directly to a protected URL, then I am redirected to the login screen.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Role-based UI (Guest, Registered User, Administrator views)
issue.description: As a user of a given role, I want to see only the navigation and actions permitted to me so that the interface matches what I am allowed to do. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I am a Guest, when I open the app, then I can view dog profiles via QR but cannot see edit or admin controls. * Given I am an Administrator, when I open the app, then I see the user-management and record-moderation sections in addition to standard features.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dog registration form
issue.description: As an animal welfare worker, I want a mobile-friendly registration form so that I can register a street dog on-site quickly and accurately. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I am filling the form on a phone, when I attach a photograph, then it is captured or uploaded and shown as a preview before I submit. * Given I submit incomplete required fields, when the form validates, then I am shown exactly which fields need attention.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dog profile view and edit screens
issue.description: As a user, I want to view a dog's profile and, if permitted, edit it so that I can check or correct its details. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I open a dog's profile as a Guest, when the screen renders, then only publicly permitted information is shown and no edit controls appear. * Given I open a dog's profile as an authorised role, when I edit and save, then the updated information is reflected immediately.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dog search screen (by ID)
issue.description: As a user, I want to search for dogs by keyword or location so that I can find the dog I'm looking for without scrolling a full list. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I enter a search term, when results load, then matching dogs are shown with enough detail (photo, ID, status) to identify the right one. * Given I search by location, when results load, then they are shown ordered by distance, with the option to view on a map if available.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Mobile-responsive layout across dog management screens
issue.description: As a field worker using a phone, I want the registration, profile and search screens to adapt to small screens so that I can use them comfortably in the field. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a screen width of 360-420px, when any dog-management screen renders, then all controls are reachable without horizontal scrolling and touch targets are appropriately sized.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Administrator dog records management screen
issue.description: As an administrator, I want a screen listing all dog records with edit/merge/remove actions so that I can maintain data quality. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I am an administrator, when I open the records-management screen, then I can filter, edit, merge or remove records, with a confirmation step before any destructive action.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Vaccination record entry and history screens
issue.description: As a veterinarian or animal welfare worker, I want to add a vaccination record and view a dog's vaccination history so that I can keep and check its rabies/vaccine status at a glance. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I open a dog's profile, when I add a vaccination record, then it appears immediately at the top of the vaccination history list. * Given a dog has overdue vaccinations, when I view its history, then overdue entries are visually flagged.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Sterilisation record entry and status screens
issue.description: As a veterinarian, I want to record and view a dog's sterilisation status so that I can quickly confirm whether a dog still needs the procedure. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I open a dog's profile, when sterilisation status is set, then it is shown clearly (e.g. a status badge) on the profile summary.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Medical treatment entry and history screens
issue.description: As a veterinarian or animal welfare worker, I want to record a treatment and view a dog's treatment history so that ongoing care for wounds or illness is coordinated between everyone involved. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I add a treatment record, when I save it, then it appears in the dog's treatment history with my identity and the date. * Given a treatment record is unverified, when a veterinarian views it, then a "verify" action is available.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dog health summary view
issue.description: As any user, I want a health summary section on a dog's profile so that I can immediately see whether it's vaccinated, sterilised and free of unresolved treatments. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a dog's profile is open, when the health summary loads, then vaccination, sterilisation and treatment status are each shown with a clear up-to-date/overdue indicator.

issue.summary: [Frontend] QR code display and download for dog profile
issue.description: As an animal welfare worker, I want to view and download/print a dog's QR code so that it can be attached to the dog's collar band. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a dog's profile is open, when I select "View QR code", then the code is displayed and can be downloaded as an image.

issue.summary: [Frontend] QR scanning workflow and invalid-code handling
issue.description: As any user with a phone, I want to scan a dog's QR code and be taken straight to its profile, with a clear message if the code isn't recognised, so that I can quickly check on a dog I've found. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I scan a valid QR code, when the camera recognises it, then I am taken directly to that dog's profile without extra steps. * Given I scan an invalid or damaged code, when resolution fails, then I see a plain-language error explaining the code wasn't recognised, with an option to try again.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Record verification screen
issue.description: As a veterinarian, I want a screen listing unverified records so that I can review and verify or reject them efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: * Given unverified records exist, when I open the verification screen, then they are listed with enough context (dog, submitter, date, details) to make a decision without navigating away.

issue.summary: [Frontend] User management screen (administrator)
issue.description: As an administrator, I want a screen to view and manage registered users so that I can adjust roles and deactivate accounts when needed. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the user list is open, when I change a user's role or deactivate them, then the change is confirmed before being applied and reflected immediately in the list.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dashboard screen with KPI cards and charts
issue.description: As an administrator or stakeholder, I want a dashboard showing key statistics and charts so that I can understand programme coverage and progress at a glance. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the dashboard loads, when statistics are displayed, then total dogs, vaccination coverage and sterilisation coverage are each shown as a KPI card and reflected in at least one chart. * Given the underlying data changes, when the dashboard is refreshed, then the figures update to match.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Offline access support
issue.description: As a field worker in an area with poor connectivity, I want to view previously loaded dog information while offline so that I can still work without a signal. Acceptance Criteria: * Given dog data was loaded while online, when the device loses connectivity, then previously viewed profiles remain accessible from local cache. * Given I am offline, when I attempt an action requiring the network, then I see a clear indicator that I am offline rather than a silent failure.

issue.summary: [Frontend] GPS location capture in registration and search
issue.description: As an animal welfare worker, I want to capture my current GPS location when registering a dog so that its location is recorded automatically and accurately. Acceptance Criteria: * Given location permission is granted, when I register a dog, then my current coordinates are attached to the record automatically, with the option to adjust manually.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Dark and light theme support
issue.description: As a user, I want the app to support both dark and light themes so that it's comfortable to use in different lighting conditions. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I switch between dark and light mode, when either theme is active, then all screens remain fully legible and usable, matching the selected theme.

issue.summary: [Frontend] Offline changes queue and sync status UI
issue.description: As a field worker, I want to see which of my offline changes are pending sync and which have succeeded or conflicted so that I trust the data I entered was saved. Acceptance Criteria: * Given I made changes while offline, when connectivity returns, then I see a sync status indicator progress from "pending" to "synced" for each change. * Given a change conflicts during sync, when this occurs, then I am shown which record conflicted and prompted to resolve it.
